subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: What measurement scope and acceptance criteria should count as sufficient for the native-Linux reasoning-latency analysis requested in #53600?
rationale: The codebase has partial observability, but deciding the target host profile, layers to measure, and whether the deliverable is a docs runbook or new instrumentation requires maintainer product direction.

options.title: Scope a diagnostics-first runbook
options.body: Define the VPS profile, required telemetry/prep-stage captures, and expected output table before queuing implementation or docs work.

options.title: Split into narrower issues
options.body: Keep #53600 as a parent and route MCP, memory, context, Telegram, and OS/runtime latency questions into separate owned follow-ups.

options.title: Wait for partial PRs first
options.body: Pause this broad analysis until #78958 and #81787 are resolved, accepting that the main request remains unanswered for now.

recommendation.title: Scope a diagnostics-first runbook
recommendation.body: Define the VPS profile, required telemetry/prep-stage captures, and expected output table before queuing implementation or docs work.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history connects this owner to the embedded-runner diagnostics and telemetry/docs surfaces needed to scope the runbook.
